name: Mystral Lake
summary: Travelers from the Horde and Alliance come to Mystral Lake in south-central Ashenvale. Its deep waters draw them beneath the night elves’ watch.

sections.title: The Forest's Great Lake
sections.body: Mystral Lake draws travelers to its shores in southern Ashenvale. It lies south of Silverwind Refuge and east of Talondeep Vale, and no lake in the forest is larger. Night elves keep watch from their outpost on the northern shore. Travelers of both the Horde and the Alliance often find their journeys bringing them here.

sections.title: Spiritual Crossroads
sections.body: Horde shaman come to Mystral Lake during trials of elemental communion. In its deep waters, they seek to understand the element of water. The lake’s primal resonance makes it an essential pilgrimage for those learning to bind and respect the tidal spirits.

faq.answer: Mystral Lake lies in south-central Ashenvale, south of Silverwind Refuge and east of Talondeep Vale. It is the forest’s largest open body of water.

faq.q: Why do shaman visit Mystral Lake?
faq.answer: Horde shaman visit Mystral Lake during spiritual trials for the Call of Water. Its deep elemental resonance helps them understand and attune to water spirits.

aliases: is mystral lake horde or alliance
faq.answer: Neither faction holds direct military control over Mystral Lake. The night elves watch it from their outpost at Silverwind Refuge on the northern shore.

angles.text: As a shaman, you come to Mystral Lake during the Call of Water. There, you confront local spirits to master your elemental craft.
From Silverwind Refuge, your people watch over Ashenvale’s largest lake, at the heart of the forest they defend.
